notes: The reference migration run: fifteen of the workflow's sixteen nodes completed under the cockpit driver, with every one of its six gates answered from a file. The task directory sits under the plural type directory, .maister/tasks/migrations/, which is what the task-directory layout freezes for this workflow. The frozen workflow: block carries the shipped definition's graph hash and node_summaries sits beside it, one entry per node, the skipped one included. Both guarded stretches are represented, and each one's guard value is visible in the state that decided it: verification declared issues_to_resolve, so issue-resolution and its closing gate ran, and the run was not asked for a user guide, so documentation is recorded as skipped - with its entry kept, its reason under orchestrator.skipped_phases, and options.docs_enabled false beside it - rather than left out of the graph. A skipped node absent from the frozen block is indistinguishable from a node that never existed, which is the whole reason it is written. The workflow's own context block is migration_context - the classified type, the two systems, the strategy, the risk level, the breaking changes, the rollback and dual-run flags, the resolved-clarifications flag and the four phase summaries keyed by this workflow's own names, each carrying the node it came from, the key implementation owned by the node execution - and there is no second context block, because a run whose state carries two is a run two interpreters wrote. Artifacts keep the A4 layout, and only the two files the fixture actually carries are listed on a summary: implementation/work-log.md, which is on the A5 exempt list and carries no summary block, and verification/implementation-verification.md, which is A5-registered and opens with one. The compatibility report the verification node also declares is not among them, so no summary points at it; every other node's artifacts list is empty rather than naming a file that is not here. dashboard-data.js is generated from the state rather than written beside it, so the projection and the state it projects cannot drift. Synthetic rather than sampled: the run it describes is the shape an engine run of this workflow writes, built to the same schemas the sampled runs are held to, with no absolute path belonging to anyone.
